pr_body:
Adaptation of the DMA driver of the stm32U5 to use with UART in async (DMA) mode.
The serial uart driver is changed to support the dma of the stm32U5.

Creates the configuration with overlay files for : 
-  nucleo_u575zi_q nucleo (144) board 
-  b_u585i_iot02a disco kit

to run tests/drivers/uart/uart_async_api.

The DMA of the stm32u5 is a GPDMA.
From the dma API, the _suspend_ function is added to the dma_driver_api. This function is called by the uart driver when aborting the Tx.

Connect the Tx to Rx pins on the target platform (add the corresponding harness_config "fixture") to pass the test.

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/46326

Signed-off-by: Francois Ramu [francois.ramu@st.com](mailto:francois.ramu@st.com)
pr_comments:
After suspending the GPDMA channel for UART Tx, a delay is required (see dma_stm32_disable_stream )
One msec is compatible with nucleo_u575 and b_u585i_iot02a platforms.

issue_context.title: Async UART for STM32 U5 support
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
Is is possible to add STM32 U575/U585 support for tests/drivers/uart/uart_async_api. I'am aware that U5 DMA support is not yet merged, https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/45350  but after that would be nice time.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
To be able to build and run test: west build -p auto -b b_u585i_iot02a_ns tests/drivers/uart/uart_async_api

**Describe alternatives you've considered**

 
**Additional context**
comments:
Thanks for raising this PR.
The async UART for stm32u5 requires DMA : purpose of the #45350
Then I have a branch here https://github.com/FRASTM/zephyr/tree/uart_dma_u5 for running the uart_async_api on the nucleo_u575zi_q. 
It is not yet finalized because timeout occurs without aborting any Tx

There is a device errata for the in the stm32U575/585  [ES0499](https://www.st.com/resource/en/errata_sheet/es0499-stm32u575xx-and-stm32u585xx-device-errata-stmicroelectronics.pdf)
that prevent the use of the DMA for USART transfer :  "USART does not generate DMA requests after setting/clearing DMAT bit
_Description
If the DMA is used for data transmission (DMAT = 1 in USART_CR3 register), and the software clears DMAT bit
and sets it again to prepare the next transmission, then the peripheral does not generate DMA requests anymore.
As a result, data are not transmitted.
Workaround
• Avoid clearing DMAT.
• If clearing DMAT is needed after the end of DMA transfers, once DMAT is cleared, disable and reenable the
peripheral through UE bit of USART_CR1 register. This workaround is acceptable only if the peripheral is not
used in receiver mode._

This is the case in the tests/drivers/uart/uart_async_api/, when test_write_abort and test_forever_timeout : the DMA request (DMAT of the USART CR3 bit) is disabled and re-enabled to start a next transmission.

Please see  branch https://github.com/FRASTM/zephyr/tree/uart_dma_u5 as a first step. 
In the tests/drivers/uart/uart_async_api, there are still _test_write_abort_ and _test_forever_timeout_ tescases to fix.

During the _test_write_abort_, the uart_tx  callback  comes **before** the  uart_tx_abort 
So that when aborting the write operation, the uart_stm32_data_1.dma_tx.buffer_length  has already been set to 0 by the uart_stm32_dma_tx_cb. The test_write_abort_callback when UART_TX_DONE is completed and only 2 data received against 10 sent.
Thanks for the info. So this means that there will not be async UART support for U5 series or did I miss something ?

> Thanks for the info. So this means that there will not be async UART support for U5 series or did I miss something ?

At least it would require some heavy workaround. This is unlikely this would go upsteam.
Could you please have a look at PR https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/50968
